instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
When the onion is soft, add garlic and ground beef to the skillet. Cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes.

When the beef is done, drain any excess fat, then add water and taco seasoning. Stir to combine, then bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ heart romaine hearts

instructions.primary_message: Cut lettuce crosswise into thin shreds. Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Small dice tomato. Transfer all three to a plate.
Warm taco shells in an oven or microwave according to package instructions (optional).
To serve, divide shells between plates. Fill with taco beef, lettuce, cilantro, tomatoes, and cheese. Enjoy!
